$comment: The region registry (ADR-028, ADR-039). Data, not code: a property's settings.jurisdiction (region as ISO 3166-2, comune as its ISTAT code) selects the adapters below. A region or comune missing here, or an adapter id with no implementation registered at boot, means the obligation is not generated and the console says the manual route applies. Adding a region is adding an entry here and an adapter; no code branches on a region.
